limit_sources.max_always_loaded_body_chars: Codex concatenates AGENTS.md layers up to project_doc_max_bytes (32768 bytes, documented default) and stops at the cap. Halved so no host approaches truncation.
limit_sources.max_skill_listing_chars: Codex renders its skill listing within a small fixed character budget and drops entries on overflow; Claude Code allots roughly 1 percent of the context window. 4000 is a conservative floor across both. NOT a quoted constant -- treat as this repository's own ceiling, re-derive if a host publishes an exact figure.
limit_sources.max_description_chars: Agent Skills spec caps description at 1024 characters. Capped far tighter at 220 because descriptions are always resident for every skill on every task, and the longest description in this repository is 197 characters.
limit_sources.max_skill_md_bytes: Agent Skills spec recommends a SKILL.md body under 5000 tokens. Tokens are not directly measurable here, so this is a deliberately coarse character proxy and max_skill_md_lines below is the primary gate.
limit_sources.max_skill_md_lines: Agent Skills spec, quoted: keep SKILL.md under 500 lines. This is the exact published limit and the primary body gate.
limit_sources.measurement: Characters and lines, never estimated tokens, wherever a host publishes a character or line limit. Where only a token limit exists (max_skill_md_bytes) the character figure is an explicit coarse proxy, not a measurement. Counts are LF-normalized via read_text().
limit_sources.file_budgets: A key may be a literal path or a glob; a glob binds each matched file on its own and never their sum. The references cap of 16384 bytes is the ceiling max_always_loaded_body_chars already uses, applied per file to the on-demand surface: largest today 14838 (work-github-playbook.md), about 10 percent of headroom. A task loads SEVERAL references, not one -- routing.md itself sends every dispatch through delegation.md and roles.md -- so this bounds the worst single file rather than a session total, and that is deliberate. #4458 decided against a pool spanning that surface, because under a pool the only way to fund one file's growth is deleting an unrelated file's prose, which lowers nothing any session actually loads. Under a per-file cap the file that grew is the file that pays and the fix is to split it -- though a split half is usually reached from the other, so that relocates load rather than removing it. Incentive locality is the whole claim; do not read a session total into it. What this does NOT do: 16384 x 31 permits 507904 bytes where 92938 are used, and only work-github-playbook.md is near its cap, so growth by file count or by many files growing at once passes unmetered. #3745 item 2 designated references/ the UNCOUNTED relief valve for oversized skill bodies; it is counted now, but per file and at a ceiling no skill body would hit, so the valve stays open.

forbidden_patterns.message: named model or product instead of a capability level

notes: One substantive portable entrypoint lives under .agents; host skill files are relative redirects. Ceilings are derived from documented host limits and measured in characters -- see limit_sources. Always-loaded body counts the mandatory fronts plus the entrypoint; the skill listing counts discovery metadata only. Canonical references are on-demand but included in deduplication, forbidden-pattern, stale-reference, and link checks.
